ideas.pitch: Multilingual computer-vision rural health triage and preventative screening tool for underserved communities.
ideas.problem_statement: AI For Healthcare: Build AI solutions that improve healthcare accessibility, patient support, preventive care, or medical workflows.
ideas.title: AuraScope AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines proven winner patterns: offline-first lightweight multilingual support inspired by SAGACITY and rPPG vital sensing inspired by mediscan-ai, directly targeting healthcare accessibility which judges prioritize.

ideas.pitch: Edge-AI plant pathology scanner providing hyper-localized disease diagnosis and immediate yield protection steps for smallholder farmers.
ideas.problem_statement: AI For Agriculture: Create AI-powered solutions for smart farming, crop health, agricultural intelligence, food security, or rural communities.
ideas.title: CropGuard Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent food security crisis with a high-impact, working mobile-web camera demo, ticking the measurable impact and live-working demo win patterns.

ideas.pitch: Real-time municipal waste and micro-grid energy optimization agent reducing carbon footprint and predicting localized water stress zones.
ideas.problem_statement: AI For Climate & Sustainability: Use AI to address environmental challenges, energy optimization, waste management, water conservation, or climate-related problems.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Optima
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies multi-agent reasoning similar to the claim-bias-evaluator to environmental resource allocation, appealing directly to sustainability metrics that climate judges look for.

ideas.pitch: Simulated disaster response coordination platform using aerial drone footage analysis and offline-resilient LLM triage for emergency responders.
ideas.problem_statement: AI For Safety & Disaster Response: Develop AI solutions for emergency response, risk detection, cybersecurity, public safety, or disaster management.
ideas.title: ResQ-Mesh AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: High-urgency real-world problem with a heavy technical edge-AI component, satisfying the genuinely hard engineering pattern seen in past grand prize winners.

ideas.pitch: Automated algorithmic compliance and ethical bias auditor for autonomous generative AI decision pipelines in enterprise and public sectors.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation — AI For The Future: Build an innovative AI-powered solution for any meaningful real-world problem.
ideas.title: TrustAudit AI
ideas.track: Open Innovation — AI For The Future
